mentions.name: askdiff
mentions.description: A GitHub PR review style web app that attaches to the same Claude Code session that wrote the code, letting developers review AI-written code and ask questions about the diff without opening draft PRs and copy-pasting diffs back to the session.
mentions.problem: The author hit a workflow bottleneck checking code written by Claude Code: it required opening big draft PRs and then copy-pasting the diff back to the session to ask questions.
